# Stage 7: Final Validation

**Purpose:** Two-phase gate before Stage 8 (Code Insertion):
1. **Pre-Compilation Validation** — validates all generated code against skill files, WPF SDK, and project structure *before* running `dotnet build`
2. **Post-Build Quality Validation** — validates accessibility, security, performance, resource integrity, and Syncfusion integration *after* a clean build

**Input:** All files generated by Stage 5 + `skill-extraction.json` (Stage — Control Skill Extraction)
**Output:** Validation report with binary PASS ✓ / FAIL ✗ per check + overall result

⛔ **Phase 1 must pass before `dotnet build` is invoked. Phase 2 runs only after build succeeds.**

---

## Phase 1: Pre-Compilation Validation

> **Full rules:** `Build.md` — this section summarises the mandatory checks. Refer to `Build.md` for pseudocode, element-level property tables, and auto-fix loop details.

---

### Pre-Check 1: Skill-Based API Validation (CRITICAL)

Load `skill-extraction.json`. For every Syncfusion control in any `.xaml` or `.cs` file:

```
FOR EACH Syncfusion control in generated files:
  1. FIND entry in skill-extraction.json → controls[]
     ❌ Not found → HALT: "Control '<ControlName>' not in skill-extraction.json
                           Fix: re-run Stage — Control Skill Extraction, then return to Stage 7."

  2. VALIDATE namespace matches controls[].namespace exactly
     ❌ Mismatch → HALT: "Namespace mismatch for '<ControlName>'
                          Used: <used_xmlns> | Expected: <expected_xmlns>"

  3. VALIDATE every property is in controls[].valid_properties[].name
     ❌ Not found → HALT: "Property '<propName>' on '<ControlName>' not in skill docs
                           Valid: [<list>] | Fix: remove or re-extract skill file"

  4. VALIDATE every event is in controls[].valid_events[].name
     ❌ Not found → HALT: "Event '<eventName>' on '<ControlName>' not in skill docs"

  5. VALIDATE every method is in controls[].valid_methods[].name
     ❌ Not found → HALT: "Method '<methodName>' not verified in skill file"
```

---

### Pre-Check 2: WPF SDK Compliance

**Framework-level blocked properties** (WinUI/UWP-only — not valid in WPF):

| Property / API | Belongs To | WPF Alternative |
|---|---|---|
| `RowSpacing`, `ColumnSpacing` | WinUI Grid | `Margin` on child elements |
| `Spacing` on `StackPanel` | WinUI | `Margin` on child elements |
| `x:Bind` | WinUI | `{Binding}` |
| `RelativePanel.*` | WinUI | `Grid` or `Canvas` |
| `CommandBarFlyout`, `MenuFlyout` | WinUI/UWP | `ContextMenu` |
| `Windows.UI.*` types | WinUI/UWP | `System.Windows.*` |

```
IF any blocked property found → HALT: "Property '<name>' not valid in WPF SDK (<framework>)
                                        File: <file>, Line: <line>"
```

**Element-level property compliance** (examples — applies to ALL WPF properties):

Before setting any property on any element, confirm it is declared in that element's WPF SDK class hierarchy. The table below shows the most common violations:

| Property | Supported On | ❌ Not Supported On |
|---|---|---|
| `Padding` | `Control` subclasses, `Border` | `Grid`, `StackPanel`, `DockPanel`, `WrapPanel`, `Canvas` |
| `CornerRadius` | `Border` | `Grid`, `Button`, `StackPanel`, any non-Border |
| `Background` | `Panel`, `Control`, `Window`, `Border` | Plain `UIElement`/`FrameworkElement` subclasses |
| `Content` | `ContentControl` subclasses | `Panel`, `TextBlock`, `Image` |
| `Text` | `TextBox`, `TextBlock`, `RichTextBox` | `Button`, `Label`, `Border`, `Grid` |
| `Header` | `HeaderedContentControl` (`GroupBox`, `TabItem`) | Plain `Control`, `Panel` |
| `IsChecked` | `ToggleButton` subclasses | `Button`, `Label`, any non-ToggleButton |
| `Orientation` | `StackPanel`, `WrapPanel` | `Grid`, `DockPanel`, `Canvas` |

General rule: trace `<ElementType>` up its base class hierarchy — if the property is not declared on any class in that chain, it does not exist on that element.

```
IF property not in element's WPF class hierarchy
→ HALT: "Property '<name>' does not exist on '<ElementType>' in WPF SDK
         File: <file>, Line: <line>
         Fix: use a supported container or the correct property for this element type"
```

Also validate value type compatibility per `Build.md` (Background expects Brush, Margin expects Thickness, FontSize expects double, etc.).

---

### Pre-Check 3: XAML Structural Validation

Simulate `XamlReader.Parse()` on every `.xaml` file (dry-run — before compile):

```
Check for:
  ├── Tag mismatch (e.g., <Border> closed with </DataTemplate>)
  │   → HALT: "XAML tag mismatch in <file>: '<OpenTag>' vs '</CloseTag>' at line <n>"
  ├── Invalid XML (MC3000 / MC3072)
  │   → HALT: "Invalid XAML in <file>: <parser message> at line <n>"
  ├── Missing WPF base namespace
  │   → HALT: "Missing xmlns='http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation'"
  └── WinUI/UWP/MAUI namespace detected
      → HALT: "Non-WPF namespace '<ns>' detected — mixed framework not allowed"

Auto-fix loop (max 3 attempts):
  Fixable errors (missing tag, wrong attribute type) → apply fix → retry parse
  Cascading errors detected → HALT: "Cascading XAML errors — manual review required"
  3 attempts exhausted → HALT: "XAML parse failed — return to Stage 5 to regenerate"
```

---

### Pre-Check 4: Runtime Exception Prevention

```
Detect before compile:
  ├── XamlParseException — invalid Effect type/color
  │   → HALT: "Invalid Effect property on '<element>' — will throw at runtime"
  ├── Missing DataContext assignment in Window constructor
  │   → HALT: "DataContext not assigned in '<Window>' — bindings will fail at runtime"
  ├── {StaticResource key} not defined in MergedDictionaries
  │   → HALT: "StaticResource '<key>' not defined — will throw XamlParseException at runtime"
  └── Event handler declared in XAML but missing in code-behind
      → HALT: "Handler '<name>' declared in XAML but not found in code-behind"
```

---

### Pre-Check 5: NuGet Dependency Validation

```
FOR EACH nuget_package in skill-extraction.json → controls[]:
  IF package missing from .csproj:
    → dotnet add package <nuget_package> (resolved version or wildcard)
    → dotnet restore
    → IF restore fails → HALT: "Package '<nuget_package>' could not be installed"

Core packages — always required:
  ✅ Syncfusion.Shared.WPF
  ✅ Syncfusion.Licensing
  ✅ Syncfusion.SfSkinManager.WPF
  ✅ Syncfusion.Themes.<LockedThemeName>.WPF

IF any Syncfusion packages use different versions:
  → HALT: "Version mismatch — all Syncfusion packages must use identical versions"
```

**Namespace error resolution (most common build failure):**
```bash
# 1. Check installed packages
dotnet list package | grep Syncfusion
# 2. Compare with skill-extraction.json → nuget_package field
# 3. If missing: dotnet add package <package-name> --version <version>
# 4. Retry: dotnet build
```
❌ Do NOT fallback to native WPF controls — ❌ Do NOT guess package names

---

### Pre-Check 6: MVVM & Binding Integrity

```
FOR EACH .xaml file:
  ├── {Binding X} → property X exists in ViewModel
  │   → HALT: "Binding '<X>' not found in <ViewModel> — File: <file>, Line: <line>"
  ├── {Binding XCommand} → ICommand XCommand exists in ViewModel
  │   → HALT: "Command '<XCommand>' not found in <ViewModel>"
  └── Event handler X in XAML → method X in code-behind
      → HALT: "Handler '<X>' declared in XAML but missing in <file>.xaml.cs"

FOR EACH ViewModel:
  ├── Implements INotifyPropertyChanged
  │   → HALT: "<ViewModel> missing INotifyPropertyChanged"
  └── No business logic in code-behind
      → HALT: "Business logic in code-behind of <file>.xaml.cs — move to ViewModel/Service"
```

---

### Build Execution (After All Pre-Checks Pass)

```bash
cd <project-root>
dotnet build
```

| Result | Action |
|---|---|
| **0 errors** | ✅ Proceed to Phase 2 |
| **Build failed** | ⛔ STOP — map error to Pre-Check above; fix and re-run |
| **Warnings only** | ✅ Proceed; log for review |

---

## Phase 2: Post-Build Quality Validation

Run only after `dotnet build` succeeds with 0 errors.

---

### Check 1: WPF & MVVM Standards

| Rule | Fail Condition |
|---|---|
| MVVM separation | Business logic in code-behind |
| ViewModel binding | `{Binding X}` where `X` not a ViewModel property |
| Command binding | `{Binding XCommand}` where `XCommand` not an `ICommand` |
| Event handlers | Handler declared in XAML with no implementation in code-behind |
| DataContext | Window or UserControl missing `DataContext` assignment |
| Navigation | Complex layout: success path doesn't open target Window and close current |
| Responsive layout | Hardcoded pixel widths for fluid layout columns |

---

### Check 2: WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility

| Rule | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Color contrast | Minimum 4.5:1 for all text |
| `AutomationProperties.Name` | Required on every interactive Syncfusion control |
| `AutomationProperties.HelpText` | Required on controls needing additional context |
| Keyboard navigation | Logical tab order; all buttons triggerable via Enter/Space |
| Focus visibility | Visible focus indicator; minimum 3:1 contrast |
| No color-only state | Errors/success communicated via text or icon, not color alone |
| Touch targets | Minimum 44×44 device-independent units |

---

### Check 3: Security

| Rule | Fail Condition |
|---|---|
| No hardcoded secrets | Passwords, API keys, connection strings in XAML or C# |
| No unsafe XamlReader | `XamlReader.Parse/Load()` on user-supplied input |
| Input validation | User inputs not validated before use |
| License key | `SYNCFUSION_LICENSE_KEY` from env var — not hardcoded |

---

### Check 4: Performance

| Rule | Requirement |
|---|---|
| List virtualization | `SfDataGrid` / `SfTreeView` with 100+ items — virtualization enabled |
| Async UI operations | Operations > 100ms use `async/await`; no `Task.Wait()` on UI thread |
| DPI-aware sizing | All sizes in DIP; no hardcoded pixel values |
| No memory leaks | Event handlers unsubscribed on `Unloaded` |

---

### Check 5: Resource Integrity

| Rule | Fail Condition |
|---|---|
| All `{StaticResource X}` defined | Any key not in merged ResourceDictionaries |
| No duplicate `x:Key` | Same key defined more than once in same file |
| Valid ARGB colors | `<SolidColorBrush>` not using `#AARRGGBB` or `#RRGGBB` format |
| Relative paths | ResourceDictionary `Source` using absolute file path |
| Custom resources only | Syncfusion theme NOT in `MergedDictionaries` |

---

### Check 6: Syncfusion Integration

| Rule | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Theme via `SfSkinManager` | `SfSkinManager.SetTheme(this, new Theme("<Name>"))` in every Window constructor |
| `ApplyStylesOnApplication` | Set to `true` in `App.xaml.cs` `OnStartup()` |
| License registered | `SyncfusionLicenseProvider.RegisterLicense(...)` before any control is used |
| Theme NuGet installed | `Syncfusion.Themes.<ThemeName>.WPF` at same version as all other Syncfusion packages |
| Controls from skill files | Every Syncfusion control verified in `getting-started.md`; no invented APIs |
| No `MergedDictionaries` for theme | Syncfusion theme NOT in `Application.Resources` |

---

## ⭐ USER DECISION #2

```
Stage 7 validation complete.  Overall: ✅ PASS / ❌ FAIL

Issues (if any):
  • Pre-Check 2: Padding on Grid — use Margin or wrap in Border
  • Check 2: SfTextInputLayout missing AutomationProperties.Name

  [A] Auto-fix all issues and proceed to Stage 8
  [B] Review and fix manually, then re-run validation
  [C] Proceed to Stage 8 anyway (not recommended if FAIL)
  [D] Cancel
```

- **A:** Apply all fixes, re-run all checks, confirm PASS, proceed to Stage 8
- **B:** Wait for user changes; re-run on request
- **C:** Warn of deployment risk; proceed only on explicit confirmation
- **D:** Halt; do not proceed to Stage 8

---

## Proceed to Stage 8 Criteria

✅ **Proceed if:** Phase 1 all PASS + `dotnet build` 0 errors + Phase 2 all PASS (or user confirms option C)
⛔ **Do not proceed if:** Build fails (no exceptions) or user has not reviewed the report
